name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor's path to motorsport security was unconventional. Starting as a systems analyst for a national security firm, she developed a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of risk assessment. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Eleanor volunteered at local racing events, quickly recognizing the unique security challenges presented by the high-stakes, fast-paced environment. Her ability to anticipate potential threats, coupled with her calm demeanor under pressure, led to her recruitment by Team Gtechniq.

Eleanor believes in a proactive, intelligence-led approach to security. She focuses on preventative measures, building strong relationships with team members, and fostering a culture of security awareness. Her background in technology allows her to leverage cutting-edge surveillance and data analysis tools to protect Team Gtechniq's assets and personnel. What sets Eleanor apart is her ability to blend technical expertise with a pragmatic, human-centered approach to security management.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Eleanor is of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with observations and potential security risks.
Insists on brewing her own tea, claiming it helps her focus.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
